claims.text: The Ranch at Rock Creek is a 19th-century homestead secluded in a Montana valley.

findings.quote: Secluded in one of Montana's most pristine valleys, The Ranch at Rock Creek's 19th-century homestead thrives in balance with its diverse eco-system.

claims.text: The Ranch is all-inclusive, so guests can leave their wallets behind.

findings.quote: grounded in its all-inclusive design, allowing guests to leave their wallets behind

claims.text: Stays include farm-to-table ranch cuisine at breakfast, lunch, social hour and dinner.

findings.quote: Farm-to-table Ranch cuisine: breakfast, lunch, social hour, and dinner.

claims.text: Twice-daily activities are included in the stay.

findings.quote: Twice-daily activities are included in your stay.

claims.text: All-inclusive rates provide equipment, gear and knowledgeable guides for morning and afternoon excursions.

findings.quote: Our all-inclusive rates provide equipment, gear and knowledgeable guides that prepare guests for excursions each morning and afternoon.

claims.text: Year-round activities include horseback riding, the gun ranges and wildlife viewing.

findings.quote: Year-round activities include horseback riding, our gun ranges, wildlife viewing, and so much more.

claims.text: Winter excursions include ice skating, cross-country skiing, snowmobiling and sledding.

findings.quote: Experience our exciting all-inclusive winter excursions such as ice skating, cross-country skiing, snowmobiling, or sledding.

claims.text: Accommodations range from lodge suites and a converted historic barn to luxury log homes and canvas glamping cabins.

findings.quote: Whether you choose a lavish lodge suite, converted Historic Barn accommodation, spacious luxury log home or canvas glamping cabin

claims.text: Granite Lodge rooms have custom-made furniture, woven textiles, frontier antiques and lavish linens.

findings.quote: Our lodge rooms are appointed with custom-made furniture, woven textiles, frontier antiques and lavish linens.

claims.text: The outdoor heated pool is open in summer, and the hot tub is open year-round.

findings.quote: Cool off in 25,000-gallon outdoor heated pool in the summer. Relax in the hot tub year-round as you gaze at the views and twinkling stars.

claims.text: Evening entertainment in the Silver Dollar Saloon includes billiards, karaoke, a private movie theater and four lanes of bowling.

findings.quote: Evening entertainment in the Silver Dollar Saloon, including billiards, poker table, shuffleboard, karaoke, table tennis, private movie theater, board games, four lanes of bowling

claims.text: The Ranch has a kids club called Flint's Forest Rangers.

findings.quote: Flint's Forest Rangers Kids Club

claims.text: Guests have four miles of private access to Rock Creek for fly fishing.

findings.quote: With four miles of private access to Rock Creek, guests can learn on some of the best fishing locations in the world.

claims.text: The original 19th-century barn, with its stables, tack room and hay loft, was restored into three accommodations: Stables, Wrangler and Loft.

findings.quote: This original structure housed stables, a tack room and a hay loft, which have been lovingly restored into three unique accommodations, Stables, Wrangler and Loft.
Our remodeled 19th-century barn captures the storied splendor of a Montana ranch vacation.

claims.text: The glamping cabins on the banks of Rock Creek are made of canvas, wood and stone, designed for sustainability.

findings.quote: These “canvas cabins” are comprised of canvas, wood and stone, designed for sustainability, with minimal impact on the environment and the wildflower meadows surrounding the creek.
Watch eagles alight on our cottonwoods as you sip your morning coffee from a hybrid glamping tent on the banks of Rock Creek.
